contentText: It's the moment all gastronomy lovers have been waiting for. On Tuesday the Michelin guide handed out its famous stars to restaurants across the world, most of which offer luxurious fine-dining at correspending prices. But the restaurant guide also hands out the 'Bib Gourmand', a special distinction for restaurants that serve high-quality food at great value. Our colleagues at France 2 paid a visit to one of them.
